runs.text: A sensor measures 5 whole temperatures. Read them and show their average as a real number, for example 24.0.
One task reads the temperatures and sends them through a channel; another receives them and computes the average.

hints.text: Who is the producer and who the consumer?
It is the pipeline of the lesson: the producer sends and closes; the consumer receives until
The consumer keeps the sum and the number of measurements, and at the end divides with
Each task keeps its own boxes: the sum lives in the consumer. Close with the variant.

runs.text: between integers gives a real, which is why 24 is shown as 24.0. The negative temperatures test that the sum can go down; the case of zeros, that there is no division by zero because 5 measurements always arrive.

assertions.requirement: The consumer receives in a loop until the channel is closed.
